Operational Excellence

One Partner, Complete Coverage

Managing waste across multiple locations shouldn't mean managing multiple vendors. Tenth Rock consolidates your waste operations under a single point of contact, giving you consistent service standards, unified reporting, and predictable costs. Our national network of vetted local vendors means you get the responsiveness of a local provider with the accountability of an enterprise partner.

  • Single point of contact for all locations
  • Unified billing and centralized reporting

  • Real-time service tracking and documentation
